info.name: GBS POS & CMS API
info.description: Postman collection for GBS POS (:8080) and CMS (:8081) APIs. Default credentials: admin/admin123 or cashier/cashier123.

request.description: Authenticate and get JWT token. Token auto-saved to `pos_token`.
List products. Optional: storeType, category, lastSync. Returns X-Last-Sync header.
Get a single product by ID. Returns product with discount and finalPrice.
List products where stockQuantity <= lowStockThreshold.
Create a new product. ADMIN only. Returns 201 Created.
Update an existing product. ADMIN only.
Delete a product. ADMIN only. Returns 204 No Content.
Adjust product stock. ADMIN only. type: IN | OUT | ADJUSTMENT. Returns updated product.
Get stock adjustment history for a product.

formdata.description: CSV file with columns: name, price, category, imageUrl, storeType, stockQuantity, lowStockThreshold

request.description: Bulk import products from CSV. ADMIN only. Returns { success, failed, errors }.
Export all products as CSV download. ADMIN only.
List all variants for a product.
Create a variant for a product. ADMIN only.
Update a variant by variant ID. ADMIN only.
Delete a variant by variant ID. ADMIN only. Returns 204.
List all discounts. Optional filters: scope (PRODUCT|TRANSACTION|VOUCHER), status.
Get discount by ID. Returns scope, productId, voucherCode, minTransaction, type, value, startDate, endDate, status, effectiveStatus.
Create PRODUCT discount. Only one active/pending product discount can overlap per product. ADMIN only.
Create TRANSACTION discount. Pricing picks the highest monetary discount. ADMIN only.
Create VOUCHER discount. Applied when voucher code is provided at checkout. ADMIN only.
Update discount. PRODUCT uses productId; TRANSACTION uses minTransaction; VOUCHER uses voucherCode. ADMIN only.
Stop an ACTIVE discount immediately (sets effectiveStatus to STOPPED). ADMIN only.
Cancel a PENDING discount before it starts. ADMIN only.
Delete a discount by ID. ADMIN only. Returns 204 No Content.
Calculate final pricing with product/transaction/voucher discounts applied. Returns per-item breakdown and totals.
Create an ACTIVE hold session.
List ACTIVE hold sessions for a terminal.
Get a hold snapshot by ID.
Resume a hold. Changes status ACTIVE -> RESUMED. Only ACTIVE holds can be resumed.
Delete an ACTIVE hold. RESUMED holds cannot be deleted.
Store or update the cart display JSON for a terminal. Protected endpoint.
Update the cart display JSON for the same terminal (UPSERT).
Get the latest cart display JSON for a terminal. Public endpoint; returns raw JSON.
Request an unknown terminal to receive the default cart display JSON.
Delete the stored cart display for a terminal. Protected endpoint. Returns 204 No Content.
List orders. Filters: storeType, isVoided, isSettled, terminalId, paymentMethod. Sorted by timestamp DESC.
Get a single order by ID.

request.description: Create an order (idempotent by id). Returns 201 on first create, 200 with idempotent:true on duplicate.
Create a CASH order with cashReceived and changeAmount.
Bulk sync orders from offline queue. Returns { orders, created, existing, failed }.
Void an order. ADMIN only. Cannot void settled or already-voided orders.
Get unsettled order summary grouped by payment method: { count, total, paymentSummary }.
Run settlement batch. ADMIN only. Atomically marks all unsettled non-voided orders as settled.
List recent settlements.
Get settlement detail by ID.
List all customers. Optional search filter.
Get customer by ID. Returns customer, totalSpent, totalOrders.
Look up a customer by phone number. Used at POS checkout to attach loyalty.
Create a new customer. phone is required and must be unique.
Update customer profile. All fields optional.
Get order history for a customer.
Get dashboard summary: totalOrders, totalRevenue, avgOrderValue, cashTotal, cardTotal, qrisTotal, voidedCount.
Get daily revenue data points: [{ date, revenue, orders }]. Used to render revenue chart.
Get top-selling products: [{ productId, productName, totalSold, revenue }].
Authenticate and get JWT token for CMS. Token saved to `cms_token`.
Upload a video ad (multipart/form-data). Max 50MB. ADMIN only.
List all ads with pagination. ADMIN only.
Get ad detail by ID. ADMIN only.
Update ad metadata. ADMIN only.
Delete ad and its file. ADMIN only. Returns 204.
Toggle ad isActive status. ADMIN only.
Get active playlist for a store type. Called by Android POS to fetch scheduled ads.
Download video file as binary stream. Called by Android POS.
Log that an ad was played (analytics). Returns 200.
Get all settings as key-value map. ADMIN only. Returns { settings: { key: value, ... } }.
Upsert settings as key-value pairs. ADMIN only. Pass only the keys you want to update.
List all users. ADMIN only.
Get user by ID. Returns id, username, name, role, gender, createdAt, updatedAt. ADMIN only.
Create a new user. ADMIN only. role: ADMIN | CASHIER. password min 6 chars.
Update user. ADMIN only. All fields optional. Omit password to keep existing.
Delete a user by ID. ADMIN only. Returns 204 No Content.
